title: Reviewer contract permits an Engram ls the delegation policy refuses
outcome: /review-code promises reviewer children only the tracker words they can actually use, or states that its dedupe step is best-effort — so no reviewer packet claims a dedupe that never ran.
acceptance: A reviewer delegation either completes the Phase 6 dedupe search successfully, or the command text tells the reviewer that dedupe is unavailable and to record that in Proposed Engram Updates
No reviewer packet presents a deduplicated proposal when no dedupe search ran
